step1.description:
When Angular broke the news they were merging with another Google framework almost no one had heard of, it caught some people by surprise. Wiz, has been powering Google most used websites for a long time. Wiz core maintainer Jatin Ramanathan joins us to talk about this incredible tool, his journey, and what he's learned along the way.
